fact_id.description: Stable unique identity for this fact — immutable

canonicalHash.description: Molecule payload hash at time of fact production

fact_type.description: Constitutional fact type — facts change constitutional reality, observations do not

weight_class.description: Constitutional facts carry full authority; operational facts are configurable within constitutional bounds

from_state.description: Prior molecule state before this fact — null if no state transition

to_state.description: New molecule state after this fact — null if no state transition

governance_ref_id.description: governance_id of the JournalGovernanceRecord that authorised this fact

observation_refs.description: observation_ids that informed the governance decision producing this fact

challenge_id.description: If challenge-related — the challenge this fact resolves or records

survival_type.description: For survived_challenge — how the molecule survived

successor_id.description: For superseded facts — molecule_id of the successor

scope_definition.description: For contextualised facts — explicit boundary declaration

actor_id.description: Who or what produced this fact

actor_domain_id.description: Which trust domain the actor belongs to

actor_trust_score.description: Snapshot of actor trust at time of fact — frozen forever, prevents retroactive manipulation

quorum_domains.description: For multi-domain governance facts — domain_ids that formed the quorum

triage_tier.description: For classification_event facts — triage tier assigned

payment_amount.description: For payment facts — total payment amount

payment_model.description: For payment facts — which payment model generated this

governance_reserve_amount.description: For payment facts — 12% reserve deducted per C-23

escrow_amount.description: For escrow facts — amount held pending challenge resolution per C-21

constitution_version.description: Constitution version under which this fact was produced — v1.0

fact_hash.description: Hash of this fact content chained with prior entry hash — integrity chain

prior_entry_hash.description: Hash of the immediately preceding journal entry

runtime_id.description: For molecule_created — which Origin Runtime execution produced this fact, linking the constitutional birth event back to its execution trace
